# Miracle Flooring

> Premier craft-driven hardwood installation, dust-controlled sanding & refinishing, luxury vinyl plank (LVP), and custom staircases in Marietta and North Metro Atlanta, GA.

## Overview
Miracle Flooring is a specialized flooring contractor based in Marietta, Cobb County, Georgia (4107 Christacy Way, Marietta, GA 30066). The company provides precision wood flooring solutions for residential and commercial property owners seeking high-ticket craftsmanship, dust containment, transparent pricing, and direct owner-supervised installations.

## Core Capabilities
- [Hardwood Flooring Installation](https://miracleflooringa.com/#services): Solid & engineered hardwood installation, herringbone and plank layouts, subfloor moisture testing, and wood acclimation protocols.
- [Dust-Controlled Sanding & Refinishing](https://miracleflooringa.com/#services): Multi-stage rotary sanding with particle containment, custom stain matching, and commercial-grade low-VOC waterborne polyurethane finishes (matte, satin, semi-gloss).
- [Luxury Vinyl Plank & Laminate](https://miracleflooringa.com/#services): 100% waterproof SPC rigid core LVP with 20mil+ commercial wear layers, acoustic underlayment, and subfloor leveling.
- [Custom Hardwood Stairs & Floor Repairs](https://miracleflooringa.com/#services): Replacing carpet with solid hardwood treads, clean white risers, flush nosing, and invisible board lacing/weaving repairs.
